local_scans.encoding_note: r_name is dictionary-encoded uint8; compare dict index for 'ASIA'
n_name is dictionary-encoded uint8; resolve to string at output time

operators.description: Scan region (5 rows), find r_regionkey where r_name='ASIA'. Scan nation (25 rows), filter n_regionkey = asia_regionkey. Build two structures: (a) bitset asia_nationkeys[25] marking 5 ASIA nations, (b) direct_array nationkey_to_name[25] mapping nationkey -> n_name dict index.
Iterate hash_supplier_by_suppkey, filter s_nationkey IN asia_nationkey_set. Build suppkey_to_nationkey map for qualifying suppliers.

data_structures.sizing_note: max s_suppkey = 100000 at SF10; direct_array[100001] of int8 = ~100KB, fits in L1 cache

operators.predicate_note: 1994-01-01 = epoch day 8766, 1995-01-01 = epoch day 9131; raw int32 comparison on encoded column

operators.description: For each date-filtered order, probe customer hash on o_custkey. If customer exists AND c_nationkey is an ASIA nation, emit (o_orderkey, c_nationkey). Build orderkey_to_custnation hash map from results.

data_structures.sizing_note: 428K entries, ~6MB at 75% load factor; fits in L3 cache (44MB)

operators.description: Stream all 60M lineitem rows. For each row: (1) probe orderkey_to_custnation on l_orderkey to get c_nationkey; if miss, skip. (2) Index suppkey_to_nationkey[l_suppkey] to get s_nationkey; if -1, skip. (3) Check s_nationkey == c_nationkey; if mismatch, skip. (4) Accumulate revenue = l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) into thread-local agg array by nationkey.
operators.per_thread_state: double revenue[25], zero-initialized; index by nationkey; 200 bytes per thread

operators.description: Sum all thread-local revenue[25] arrays element-wise. Extract 5 non-zero entries (ASIA nation keys). Map nationkey to n_name using nationkey_to_name + nation name dictionary.

operators.sort_note: Only 5 rows; use simple insertion sort or std::sort

parallel_operators: step_4 (customer probe, parallel build into concurrent hash map)
parallelism.notes: Step 5 dominates runtime (60M row scan + two hash probes per row). Morsel-driven parallelism on lineitem with thread-local aggregation arrays avoids contention. Steps 3-4 can also be parallelized for the orders filter+customer probe phase, building orderkey_to_custnation concurrently.
